name: Tomboy Stranded in Space
storyline:
As the maintenance officer aboard a space station, you thought you had seen everything that could go wrong in space, until catastrophe hits the crew...

After a massive solar flare hits the space station and forces the rest of the crew to evacuate, it is up to you to repair the antennas and call for a rescue mission before it is too late!
summary: Stranded in space with a tomboy!? A freak solar flare leaves you stranded in a space station with Eva, a confident and athletic tomboy woman. Work on your rescue mission and learn about Eva's life, about her hopes and dreams, as you slowly become her confidante and you learn to love each other.
